name: agent-runner
description: Run one coding agent from start to end: its own checkout, one prompt, the agent's own loop, a run record on the project's agent-data branch; resume a run that ended on a question; and the sweep a scheduler runs to record the runs whose process died.

scripts.build: pnpm -C ../agent-data build && pnpm -C ../skill-branches build && pnpm -C ../skill-logs build && pnpm -C ../agent-driver build && pnpm -C ../agent-driver-claude build && pnpm -C ../agent-driver-codex build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C ../agent-data build && pnpm -C ../skill-branches build && pnpm -C ../skill-logs build && pnpm -C ../agent-driver build && pnpm -C ../agent-driver-claude build && pnpm -C ../agent-driver-codex build && tsc --noEmit
